dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you, too.

dialogue.content: 最初に年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 50代、男性
dialogue.English: I'm a man in my 50s.

dialogue.content: お返事ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 娘の引きこもりについてですが、よろしいですか。
dialogue.English: I'd like to talk about my daughter's social withdrawal, if that's alright.

dialogue.content: はい　ご一緒に考えさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Of course. I'm here to help you think through this.

dialogue.content: 娘さんはお歳はおいくつですか？
dialogue.English: How old is your daughter?

dialogue.content: 26歳の娘、大学2年生のときから6年位引きこもっています
dialogue.English: She's 26. She's been withdrawn for about six years, since her second year of university.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはご心配ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.content: 毎日このことを考えない日はないです…
dialogue.English: Not a day goes by that I don't think about it...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。娘さんは最近の様子はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. How has your daughter been doing recently?

dialogue.content: 家にいる生活が長く、コロナでなおさら出ませんから、とくになんの疑問もなく家で淡々と過ごしています
dialogue.English: She's been living at home for a long time, and with COVID, she goes out even less. She just seems to be spending her days at home matter-of-factly, without questioning it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。コロナ禍になってしまいましたので、誰もが家から出ずらくなっていますからね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. The pandemic has made it difficult for everyone to go out, hasn't it...

dialogue.content: かえって出なくてはいけないプレッシャーがなくて本人にはいいのかもしれませんが…
dialogue.English: It might actually be better for her, in a way, since there's no pressure to go out...

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません。
dialogue.English: That may be the case.

dialogue.content: 引きこもりが長くなるほど社会に出るきっかけも作れなくなりそうです。どうしたらいいのか。。
dialogue.English: But the longer she's withdrawn, the harder it seems it will be for her to find a chance to re-enter society. I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: その点がご心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: That's what you're concerned about, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 娘さんはコロナ禍のこと、何と言っていますか？
dialogue.English: What does your daughter say about the pandemic?

dialogue.content: とくに何も言っていないです、外へ出ないので、あまり気にもならないのでしょうか…
dialogue.English: She doesn't say anything in particular. Since she doesn't go outside, perhaps it doesn't really concern her...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。かえって、外に出なくてはというプレッシャーもなくと言うお話しでしたものね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. And as you mentioned, it might be that she feels less pressure to go out...

dialogue.content: はい。人となるべく会いたくないのでしょう、大勢の人とのコミュニケーションが苦手な子ですから。
dialogue.English: Yes. I think she wants to avoid people as much as possible. She's not good at communicating with large groups of people.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは普段はご家族とはどんな話をするのですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things does your daughter usually talk about with the family?

dialogue.content: あまり話さないですね、たわいもないことですね。今日の食事は何？みたいなことです。
dialogue.English: She doesn't talk much—just small talk, like, "What's for dinner today?"

dialogue.content: お家にいると、食事のことが一番気になるのでしょうね・・・
dialogue.English: When you're at home all day, meals probably become the main thing to think about...

dialogue.content: 娘さんは居間に出てきてご一緒にテレビを見たりしているのですか？
dialogue.English: Does your daughter come into the living room to watch TV with you all?

dialogue.content: 食事の用意を手伝ったり、掃除をしたり、もくもくと家のことはしていますが、自分の部屋にいることが多いです。
dialogue.English: She helps prepare meals and clean—quietly does things around the house—but she spends most of her time in her room.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お母様の家事のお手伝いをしてくれるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So she helps your wife with the housework.

dialogue.content: はい、ただ、母親に本心を話すことは今までもなく、母親との心の距離はあるように思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, but she has never really opened up to her mother. I feel there's some emotional distance between them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。パートナーさんはその辺の所何とおっしゃっているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What does your partner say about that?

dialogue.content: 嫁はマイペースな人で。韓国人なので、言葉も文化も日本に馴染まず、育児にも向いてないというか。。娘は父親の方をより信用していた気がします。嫁は娘にどうしたらいいかわからず、どうこうしようともしていないです。
dialogue.English: My wife does things at her own pace. She's Korean, so she hasn't quite adapted to the Japanese language and culture, and you could say parenting hasn't come easily to her. I feel our daughter trusted me, her father, more. My wife doesn't know what to do for our daughter and isn't trying to do anything about it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it's been.

dialogue.content: お父様としても、娘さんのことでは育児からいろいろ気を遣って来られたのでしょうね・・・
dialogue.English: As her father, you must have been very involved and attentive in raising your daughter...

dialogue.content: はい、普通母親が関わることも言葉の問題があるので、私が代わりにしたりしてきました。
dialogue.English: Yes, because of the language issue, I often had to take on roles that a mother would normally handle.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それでは娘さんとしては、頼りはお父様という感じのようですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. So for your daughter, it seems like you've been the one she relies on...

dialogue.content: まあ、そうなのかもしれませんが、男親ですからね、いいたいことも言えないこともあるでしょうし。
dialogue.English: Well, that might be true, but since I'm her father, there are probably things she feels she can't say to me.

dialogue.content: 娘は、２つ上の長女に1番話ができるのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: She might be able to talk most openly with her older sister, who is two years older.

dialogue.content: お姉さんがいらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: So she has an older sister.

dialogue.content: 姉妹ではよく話をしている様子ですか？
dialogue.English: Do the sisters seem to talk often?

dialogue.content: はい、長女も母親とは馴染ます、家を出て、ずっと海外で日本語教師をしています。
dialogue.English: Yes. My older daughter also didn't get along well with her mother. She left home and has been working abroad as a Japanese teacher for a long time.

dialogue.content: コロナでずっと会えていませんね。
dialogue.English: They haven't been able to see each other because of COVID.

dialogue.content: 娘同士はラインはするみたいですけどね。
dialogue.English: It seems the sisters do chat on LINE, though.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それも、コロナ禍の影響ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's another effect of the pandemic, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも今の若い人たちはLINEで結構コミュニケーションをとっているみたいですね。
dialogue.English: But it seems that young people these days communicate quite a lot through LINE.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That may be true.

dialogue.content: 娘さんにとっては、お姉さんとLINEで話を聞いてもらえるとしたら、とっても心の助けになっているのではないかと思うのですが・・・
dialogue.English: For your daughter, being able to talk to her sister on LINE and have her listen must be a great source of emotional support, don't you think?

dialogue.content: 1人でも話しやすい存在は大切ですね。でも姉のように外へ出ようという発想にはならないようですし、変化はいつまでも起きませんね。
dialogue.English: It's important to have at least one person she can talk to easily. But it doesn't seem to inspire her to go out like her sister did, so nothing ever changes.

dialogue.content: たしかに今のところはそうですね。
dialogue.English: It certainly seems that way for now.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは、大学2年から、引きこもりになったとのお話しでしたが、きっかけとか原因などについては、何かお聞きになっていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that your daughter's withdrawal started in her second year of university. Have you heard anything about what might have triggered it or caused it?

dialogue.content: もともと一対一の会話はいいけど、グループでの会話が苦手な子で、乗馬部で馴染めず、孤立していったみたいです。
dialogue.English: She was always fine with one-on-one conversations but not good with group interactions; it seems she couldn't fit in with the equestrian club and became isolated.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。大学の乗馬部で孤立していったとは、お気の毒でしたね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. It's unfortunate that she became isolated in her university's equestrian club...

dialogue.content: 心配して東京から同じ年齢の従姉妹が友達を連れて遊びに来たときも、隠れて出ませんでした。
dialogue.English: Once, her cousin of the same age came to visit from Tokyo with a friend, worried about her, but she hid and wouldn't come out.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 人の集団や社会に恐怖心があるのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: She might have a fear of groups of people or of society in general.

dialogue.content: 乗馬部の出来事からそんな心の状態になっておられるのかもしれませんね・・・
dialogue.English: It's possible that the events at the equestrian club led to her feeling this way...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までの所を少し整理させていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I took a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは現在26歳で、大学2年から約6年間引きこもり。
dialogue.English: Your daughter is currently 26 and has been withdrawn for about six years, since her second year of university.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母様は韓国の方ということで言葉の面の不便さもあって、家族とはあまり会話をしない。
dialogue.English: Her mother is from Korea, and due to language difficulties, doesn't converse much with the family.

dialogue.content: 意思疎通は出来ますが、深い話を娘から伝えられなかったかもです。
dialogue.English: They can communicate, but my daughter may not have been able to convey her deeper feelings to her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 2歳年上の姉は海外で日本語教師をしているが、この姉とは、LINEでやり取りしている様子。
dialogue.English: Her sister, two years older, teaches Japanese overseas, and it seems your daughter communicates with her via LINE.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大学2年で引きこもりになったきっかけは乗馬部でグループでのコミュニケーションがうまくとれず、孤立したことが原因らしい。
dialogue.English: The trigger for her withdrawal in her second year of university seems to be that she couldn't communicate well in a group setting at the equestrian club, which led to her isolation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は集団に対する不安を抱えているかもしれない。
dialogue.English: And now, she may be feeling anxious about being in groups.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんな理解でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that a correct understanding of the situation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 娘さんの子とご心配ですね。
dialogue.English: It's understandable that you're worried about your daughter.

dialogue.content: お父様が、娘さんの育児からいろいろ関わって来られたと理解していますが、お父様から見て、娘さんの長所はどんなところですか？
dialogue.English: I understand that you've been very involved in raising your daughter. From your perspective as her father, what would you say are her strengths?

dialogue.content: いつかは親も歳をとりますから、1人になりますよね、社会と少しでも繋がってもらいたいです。
dialogue.English: Someday, we as her parents will get old, and she'll be alone. I just want her to connect with society, even just a little.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Of course...

dialogue.content: 頭はいい子なんですよね、国立大学に合格しましたしね。
dialogue.English: She's a smart girl. She got into a national university, after all.

dialogue.content: すごい。そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: That's amazing. I see.

dialogue.content: その他に、どんな長所がありますか？
dialogue.English: What other strengths does she have?

dialogue.content: コミュニケーションができなくても何か社会に役にたつことはあると思うんですよね、絵を描くのも好きですし、読書も好きですし。。
dialogue.English: Even if communication is hard, I think there are ways she could contribute to society. She likes drawing and reading...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, absolutely.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは頭がいい方なので、ヒントがあるとご自分の生きる道を見つけていかれそうな気がするのですが・・・
dialogue.English: Given how bright she is, I feel that with the right hints she could find her own path...

dialogue.content: そうですね、どんなヒントがありますか。
dialogue.English: That's true. What kind of hints could there be?

dialogue.content: その辺については、お姉さんが娘さんとよくLINEで話しておられるようなので、お姉さんとも相談なさってみられてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Regarding that, since her older sister seems to talk with her often on LINE, perhaps you could try consulting with her sister as well?

dialogue.content: そうですが、まぁ、長女も私もどうしたらいいのか、ずっと考え続けてきていますし、2人で話をしたところで、解決策が出るとも思えないところもありましてね。。
dialogue.English: That's true, but... well, my older daughter and I have both been thinking about what to do for a long time, and I don't really think a solution will emerge just from the two of us talking about it.

dialogue.content: たしかに、少し時間がかかるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I understand, it may indeed take some time.

dialogue.content: 例えば、絵を描く趣味を生かして社会との関りをつくっていくということも考えらそうですし・・・
dialogue.English: For example, it might be possible to use her interest in drawing to build some connections with society...

dialogue.content: これからもご一緒に考えさせていただきたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I would like to continue thinking this through together with you.

dialogue.content: はい、住んでいるところが田舎なんで、なかなか繋がりを探す一歩がみつかりません。また一緒に考えてください。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, we live in the countryside, so it's hard to find that first step to make a connection. Please help me think about it again next time. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: そういう環境なのですね。そこにはひと工夫必要そうですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's the environment you're in. That will require some creative thinking.

dialogue.content: 次の機会にご一緒に考えさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: We can think about it together again next time.

dialogue.content: はい、田舎なので、周囲の目もありますから。。はい、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, since it's the countryside, we also have to worry about what the neighbors think... Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 確かに、そういうことも気になりますよね。そんな状況も踏まえてご一緒に考えてまいりたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, that is certainly a concern. I would like to help you think through this, taking that situation into account as well.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日の所は一旦この辺でよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Shall we pause here for today?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談に来てくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in to talk today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。またよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。では失礼させていただきます。
dialogue.English: Likewise, I look forward to it. Goodbye for now.
